releases.title: Updates for July 7, 2026
releases.body:
- Overhaul dashboard with module toggles and a sleeker control-center UI
- Remove personal username from homepage command preview demo
- Add DB-backed timers and multi-message welcome/goodbye commands
- Finish five partially built bot features: aliases, clownboard, logs, Pinterest, bump reminders
- Fix pricing redeem CTA looping back to pricing instead of redeem flow
- Add launch-day SEO, UX, and dashboard polish for production readiness
- Fix broken mobile menu X showing on desktop widths
- Show hamburger nav only on mobile viewports
- Fix mobile nav hamburger blocked by What's New modal
- Edit Discord changelog embeds when git release content updates
- Fix suggestions page modal, search field, and error handling
- Improve Discord OAuth diagnostics and error mapping
